pad: the keyboard pad on port 2; scancodes are the D98 config's map
per_level: stop, loadvm <tag> (stays paused), write the level's recorded lines, each +N body as @<base+N> body (base: query-xemu-frame's frame right after the load; a pipe +N counts from the frame xemu reads it at), xemu-frame-advance <frames>; RAM there; block-log totals over the run
hash: sha256[:12] of all guest RAM from xemu-dump-ram with gpu-sync false (bench-det's f<N>= is its first 16 digits)
how_recorded: one icount sitting (job 04-a): per level a paused loadvm of the tag, then Sitting.warp: the game's own debug-menu cheat code, START on 'Change level...', the D-pad to the level's row, START; the row posts (movie '', the level, spot 'startspot'); run until 20 player ticks on the ground or in water in the new level, A pressed on a stall; then 1 vblank. XEMU_INPUT_RECORD on port 2 records what the pad gave the guest. The replay in a fresh xemu must end on the sitting's RAM.
results: results-v0.15.json (job 04-a): per level its lines, frames, RAM and block-log totals
